name: vestmap-app
description: VestMap plugin marketplace — property data and Offering Memorandum tools for Claude Code.

plugins.name: vestmap
plugins.description: VestMap property data, Offering Memorandum and appraisal market-area page generation. Bundles three skills: the base vestmap data skill, the vestmap-om-pages renderer and the vestmap-market-area-pages appraisal insert.

plugins.name: rental-analyzer
plugins.description: Rental Property Analyzer — turn a rent roll + T12 + loan terms into an investor-grade pro forma: an editable Excel model (Current vs. Proforma, NOI, cap rate, DSCR, cash-on-cash, loan amortization, multi-year projection) plus a polished PDF report with KPI dashboard and charts. Standalone — no API or MCP required.
